definitions.title: ASCII Donut 3D
definitions.desc: A classic luminance-shaded torus is rebuilt from 2,160 deterministic samples into a 48 by 24 character z-buffer, with edge-aware accent light and inertial drag rotation.
definitions.seen: Seen in a1k0n's donut.c and terminal-art sketches
definitions.hint: drag to spin, use arrows, or press Space

definitions.title: ASCII Morph
definitions.desc: Two exact 30 by 16 ASCII figures interpolate glyph by glyph through a radial luminance wave with a lavender blank-transition flash.
definitions.seen: Seen in terminal-art tool builders and glyph-morph experiments by Fay and Vansh

definitions.title: Halftone Globe Canvas
definitions.desc: A deterministic halftone sphere turns through a fixed upper-left light. Stored value-noise continents, cursor-driven axis tilt, backface culling, and a restrained violet terminator make the flat dot field read as a globe.
definitions.seen: Seen on: MapTheClouds Day 54 GLSL halftone globe, editorial data maps, climate interfaces, and generative atlas identities
definitions.hint: move across the globe to tilt its axis; use arrow keys or Home while focused
